title: Volume-Based Share of the Business Cash Recovery
content:
Under the Business closure schedule of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships, the part of the Business-rate Northgate Cash that the Business Cash recovery takes depends on the business's purchasing volume: the total of the net amounts — the amounts charged after item promotions and the Northgate Card discount — of the lines on the member's Northgate orders on Northgate Store and Online Orders dated within the twelve whole calendar months before the cancellation date (dated on a day from which fewer than twelve whole calendar months have passed by the cancellation date).

| Total net amount of those lines (USD) | Share of the Business-rate Cash taken by the recovery |
|---|---|
| 5000 or more | 0.5 |
| 2000 to less than 5000 | 0.75 |
| less than 2000 | not reduced by this rule |

The recovery so reduced is rounded half up to the cent after the share is applied.

**Hypothetical illustration.** With Business-rate Cash of 8.00 and a volume of 6200.00, the recovery takes 4.00; with a volume of 3100.00 it takes 6.00.
